FOUR OF THE SEVEN WERE DUPLICATION, NOT LENGTH. _create_tracking_values held four
pairs of near-identical old/new branches; each is now one local converter applied
twice, and dict(col_info["selection"]) is built once instead of twice.

`partial` names it once. _search's two closures over (self, pid) became
_get_search_access_rows / _get_search_allowed_ids -- a closure is invisible to every
static gate and cannot be overridden by a downstream addon, a method is both.

derived once and passed.

Naming: the new helpers deliberately avoid the _prepare_mail_values_<qualifier>
family, which names the three PEER STRATEGIES (_static / _dynamic / _rendered) that
_prepare_mail_values chooses between -- a sub-helper joining it would read as a
fourth strategy. Mutators of an existing values dict are _update_*. naming,
fieldhooks, hookpurity, unresolved_calls and py_shadowed_member all measured
unchanged (130 / 284 / 24 / 25 / 0).

clause, so an AccessError raised by IT was never caught -- it stays outside the try;
and the company-escalation cookie is set inside _get_allowed_company_ids, where the
original set it, not at the single exit.
